method.images: first call per size cold, then 3 distinct warm captures; identical nativeImage PNG inputs, no real clipboard; time includes database persistence
method.lag: maximum main-thread timer delay during operation, 1 ms monitor with timer turns before/after; not renderer frame latency
method.memory: Electron process working sets summed, shared pages may be counted multiple times; includes fixtures
method.plugin: actual launch with simulated 400 ms index + 400 ms archive, or 2000 ms failure
method.appScope: Separate productivity changes are present in the after snapshot; whole-app startup/RSS are not attributable solely to performance changes
method.cpu: process.cpuUsage includes clipboard Worker threads in the main process, but excludes the separate image renderer; not total app CPU
